claim_ceiling: Synthetic design campaign only. No physical installation, approved corridor design, coupling measurement or economic benefit is claimed.

scenarios.name: Reuse existing authorized spare fibre
scenarios.conditions: Fibre owner grants rights; route, endpoints and optical budget are documented and independently calibrated.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare reuse cost and coverage against dedicated sensing alternatives on the same route.

scenarios.name: Dark fibre exists but commercial/operational rights are unresolved
scenarios.conditions: Physical fibre is available but owner, lease, permitted purpose or coexistence status is not established.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not use the fibre until rights and non-interference are approved.

scenarios.name: Sensing fibre direct-buried with independently known installation profile
scenarios.conditions: Fibre depth, soil/backfill, route, coupling and reference events are documented.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Qualify coupling and POD separately from conduit/shared-trench profiles.

scenarios.name: Fibre in conduit has reduced mechanical coupling
scenarios.conditions: Conduit installation has attenuation/damping relative to direct burial.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not inherit direct-burial POD; qualify the conduit stratum and report blind/degraded length.

scenarios.name: Sensing fibre is offset from the target cable in a shared trench
scenarios.conditions: Lateral/vertical separation varies and event propagation between cable and fibre is uncertain.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Require independent localization and asset-attribution evidence; chainage alone is insufficient.

scenarios.name: Separate sensing duct with engineered coupling and test access
scenarios.conditions: Dedicated path, calibration anchors and test points are part of the synthetic design.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare lifecycle benefit to dedicated installation CAPEX and ongoing calibration.

scenarios.name: Unrecorded fibre slack and coils at access chambers
scenarios.conditions: Optical path length differs from route station due to undocumented slack.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Require measured path/topology or maintain an unresolved transform.

scenarios.name: High splice count and optical loss across route
scenarios.conditions: Splices add loss and maintenance/uncertainty to the optical path.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure attenuation, continuity, calibration offsets and usable range per segment.

scenarios.name: Accessible endpoint and calibration test location
scenarios.conditions: Endpoints and independent tie points are accessible under owner authorization.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure reduced calibration time and maintainability without claiming field benefit.

scenarios.name: Fibre endpoint cannot be accessed for calibration or repair
scenarios.conditions: No authorized optical access or independent tie point exists.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report limited observability and cost of creating access; do not assume tap-test.

scenarios.name: Route designed with replaceable fibre sections and known splice locations
scenarios.conditions: Repair path, as-built process and recalibration procedure are explicitly declared.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Benchmark repair time and downstream transform invalidation.

scenarios.name: Water ingress affects access node, sensor and communications together
scenarios.conditions: Common-cause flooding removes sensing and access capability simultaneously.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose the blind state and compare independent point sensing/manual access alternatives.

scenarios.name: Interrogator/backhaul power or communications outage
scenarios.conditions: Local sensing may continue but remote stream is unavailable.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure local buffering, outage coverage, recovery time and evidence loss.

scenarios.name: Calibration anchors do not constrain route curvature
scenarios.conditions: Tie points are too sparse for the route topology and required error bound.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Request additional anchors or publish wider uncertainty; do not overfit smooth geometry.

scenarios.name: Construction reroute changes fibre path without updating as-built
scenarios.conditions: Existing calibration is bound to an obsolete route revision.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Invalidate all dependent geography until new as-built and calibration are accepted.

scenarios.name: Several utilities share corridor but fibre/asset access rights differ
scenarios.conditions: Sensing access for one tenant must not disclose another tenant's exact geometry or event state.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Apply owner-scoped identity, permission and disclosure; test least-privilege access.

scenarios.name: Point sensors provide adequate coverage at lower lifecycle cost
scenarios.conditions: A matched site profile shows sparse points meet the declared service requirement.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Allow a non-DAS alternative to win the economics comparison.

scenarios.name: Conventional inspection/no added sensing is economically superior
scenarios.conditions: The route has low criticality or low event exposure and inspection can meet service needs.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Keep no-added-sensing as a valid Pareto candidate; do not force DAS deployment.

scenarios.name: Sensing and power assets have independent access/common-cause profile
scenarios.conditions: Qualified compartment, route and safety separation is defined by competent engineers.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare observability while preserving separate utility engineering acceptance.

scenarios.name: Public/partner service requests exact critical fibre and splice geometry
scenarios.conditions: Audience does not have the utility owner's operational permission.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Return generalized output and deny restricted geometry.

global_controls: Existing fibre access and use require explicit owner permission.
Direct-burial and conduit coupling are separate qualification strata.
Channel pitch, gauge length, spatial resolution and sensing range are different parameters.
Fibre chainage and route geography require a versioned transformation with uncertainty.
Physical route changes invalidate downstream calibration receipts.
All in-scope route length is assigned a time- and event-specific observability state.
Point sensors and no-added-sensing are valid architecture alternatives.
Critical-asset geometry and event state are disclosed only under owner permission.
Common-cause outage and maintenance access are part of the lifecycle model.
No synthetic layout is an engineering design or authorization for construction.
